covers: direct .js files in client, shared, server, scripts, and tests
relative local import targets matched by its regex exist
relative src/href assets referenced by index.html exist
doesNotCover: vendor JavaScript (not in its folder list)

allShippedJsSyntax.command: node --check on every .js under repository, excluding node_modules

coverageReview.party: Backend/protocol coverage is substantial: matchmaking.test.js covers packing, wait/cancel, backfill, capacity, modes and FFA; social-integration.test.js covers live party leader/ready gating, cancellation, invites/expiry, capacity/leadership, bot replacement, return-to-lobby readiness, full FFA, and socket replacement. v30-character-fixes.test.js covers lobby model reuse/selection and kit synchronization, including rapid in-flight changes.
coverageReview.login: auth.test.js and auth-registration.test.js cover registration, validation, uniqueness, login identities/password failures, sessions, logout, restart persistence, origin/content-type protections, and single-device session revocation. save-accounts.test.js adds legacy/email persistence coverage.
coverageReview.countdown: session-warning.test.js verifies the replaced-session warning/countdown by source assertions (4003 event wiring, notice text, 5s CSS animation, remaining=5, reload/removal hooks). queue-dock.test.js checks queue elapsed/count display and cancellation; no runtime fake-clock assertion of countdown transitions was found.
gaps: No browser-level test exercising the rendered login/register form, validation messages, or end-to-end login UI navigation was found.
Countdown coverage is static source/regex-based rather than executing the timer and asserting each displayed second or reload timing.
Party UI rendering coverage is limited to v30 lobby/model and kit-sync unit checks; most party behavior is server/WebSocket integration rather than browser UI interaction.
